# Excluded optional binary

The imageio-ffmpeg 0.6.0 manylinux x86_64 wheel is intentionally absent from this source publication. Its original SHA256 is c7e46fcec401dd990405049d2e2f475e2b397779df2519b544b8aab515195282. The Python wrapper is BSD-2-Clause; the bundled FFmpeg 7.0.2 binary enables GPL. No new binary or FFmpeg image redistribution is approved by this source snapshot. The existing remote main and local original history are retained without rewriting.

Sources: https://pypi.org/pypi/imageio-ffmpeg/0.6.0/json ; https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html ; https://johnvansickle.com/ffmpeg/release-readme.txt .
